surface: Anime.js root and all published runtime subpaths are re-exported unchanged; useAnimeScope adds Octane scoped lifecycle ownership. The package.json entry exposes binding metadata.
divergences: `useAnimeScope` is an Octane-native lifecycle helper; it is not an upstream Anime.js API.
The Three adapter mutates raw objects while `@octanejs/three` retains frame-loop ownership; demand and never loops require explicit invalidation or advancement.
The package.json subpath reports the Octane binding identity/version rather than the upstream dependency metadata.
ssr: Supported. The hook returns inert refs during server rendering and creates no Anime.js scope until its client effect runs.
notes: Verified with real Anime.js scopes, dependency-driven cleanup, SSR rendering, the official adapter against an @octanejs/three-owned mesh, and a DOM plus demand-loop Three playground journey.
